import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

# Pairwise t-tests for all M-value pairs
data = {
    'M=32 VTC': [61.6, 59.2, 59.6],
    'M=64 VTC': [61.6, 60.0, 64.4],
    'M=96 VTC': [52.6, 58.2, 52.8],
    'M=128 VTC': [59.8, 60.2],  # 2-seed only
    'M=32 MLP': [65.2, 64.6, 60.4],
}

results = []
keys = list(data.keys())
for i in range(len(keys)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(keys)):
        a, b = np.array(data[keys[i]]), np.array(data[keys[j]])
        if len(a) < 2 or len(b) < 2:
            continue
        t, p = ttest_ind(a, b, equal_var=False)  # Welch's t-test
        # Cohen's d
        pooled_std = np.sqrt((np.std(a, ddof=1)**2 + np.std(b, ddof=1)**2) / 2)
        d = (np.mean(a) - np.mean(b)) / pooled_std if pooled_std > 0 else 0
        results.append({
            'pair': f'{keys[i]} vs {keys[j]}',
            'mean_a': np.mean(a),
            'mean_b': np.mean(b),
            'diff': np.mean(a) - np.mean(b),
            't': t,
            'p': p,
            'cohens_d': d,
            'n_a': len(a),
            'n_b': len(b),
            'significant': p < 0.05
        })

# Print as markdown table
print("| Pair | Mean A | Mean B | Diff | t | p | Cohen's d | Sig (p<.05) |")
print("|------|--------|--------|------|---|---|-----------|-------------|")
for r in results:
    sig = "✓" if r['significant'] else "✗"
    print(f"| {r['pair']} | {r['mean_a']:.1f} | {r['mean_b']:.1f} | {r['diff']:+.1f} | {r['t']:.3f} | {r['p']:.4f} | {r['cohens_d']:.3f} | {sig} |")
